correctness.rationale: For any common nonnegative insertion-gap vector, the two cyclic distances between ones are (R,N-R) and (S,N-S); rotation equivalence is exactly R=S or R+S=N. Their gap equations have coefficients in {-1,0,1} and yield the three-case exact optimum. Strict containment gives 3<=r+s<=2n-3; otherwise no length-n-1 interval appears except the identical zero-cost case. This proves the n-3 maximum. The three disjoint extremal configurations have counts 4(n-2), 4, and 4. Literal padded-word enumeration for every pair through n=8, formula censuses through n=12 and 97 longer sharp witnesses confirm the calculations.

value.rationale: The July 2026 paper explicitly asks for sharp nonasymptotic insertion-length bounds. This is the first Hamming-weight stratum with genuinely nonzero zero-only equalization cost; weight one is already rotationally identical. The result determines the optimum for every individual weight-two pair, the sharp worst case n-3 for all n, and all 4n extremal ordered pairs. It is a motivated, complete infinite-family classification rather than a routine numerical increment or arbitrary slice; it neither claims nor needs to settle the harder all-weight growth question.
